_derivation.note: Official fields derived from the Klaviyo OpenAPI specification (stable channel, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/stable/). Statistics enum values extracted from query_campaign_values.json and query_flow_values.json (identical sets, 30 statistics each). Grouping dimensions extracted from the same specs. The 'date' dimension is a derived field from the daily interval of the flow-series-reports and campaign-series-reports endpoints, not a grouping parameter per se. Enrichment source: Supermetrics Klaviyo fields catalog (https://docs.supermetrics.com/docs/klaviyo-fields.md).

drift_detected.note: The statistic 'sends' does not exist in the Klaviyo Reporting API OpenAPI spec. The correct statistic name is 'recipients'. The connector's _REPORTING_STATISTICS list uses 'sends' which will cause an API error in live runs. This drift must be resolved before live ratification.

The statistic 'revenue' does not exist in the Klaviyo Reporting API OpenAPI spec. The correct statistic name is 'conversion_value'. The connector requests 'revenue' which will cause an API error in live runs.

drift_detected.official_note: campaign_name is not a grouping dimension on campaign-values-reports. Available campaign grouping fields are: campaign_id, campaign_message_id, campaign_message_name, group, group_name, send_channel, tag_id, tag_name, text_message_format, variation, variation_name. campaign_name may be obtained by joining to the campaigns endpoint (GET /api/campaigns/{id}).

sources._fetch: curl -sL https://docs.supermetrics.com/docs/klaviyo-fields.md -o server/modules/klaviyo/catalog_sources/supermetrics.md   # DO NOT COMMIT this file (enrichment snapshot only)

_section_tier_rationale.MAGENTO: enrichment_only — Magento/WooCommerce/Stripe cross-source sections are Supermetrics-only aggregations that do not map to Klaviyo Reporting API statistics. They are advanced tier and will land as enrichment_only in the generated catalog.
_section_tier_rationale.PERSON: enrichment_only — Supermetrics exposes person-level profile attributes (email, address, city, etc.) that come from the Klaviyo Profiles API (GET /api/profiles/), not the Reporting API. These are dimensions not available in the reporting statistics endpoints.
_section_tier_rationale.PURCHASE: enrichment_only — Purchase dimensions (order_number, gateway, etc.) come from Klaviyo event data (Metrics API), not the Reporting API. Available via metric-aggregates endpoint with event-property breakdowns, which is a distinct pull path not yet implemented.
_section_tier_rationale.LIST: advanced — List membership metrics (subscribed, unsubscribed_from_list) come from the Klaviyo Lists API / Events API, not the Reporting API. Advanced enrichment tier.
_section_tier_rationale.AD: advanced — Ad attribution dimensions from third-party integrations (Facebook Ads, etc.) are stored as UTM properties on profiles, not Reporting API statistics.

probe.structural_note: Klaviyo reporting POSTs a statistics[] list (with sparse fieldset filters) on the selected account over a 1-day window. The probe batches up to 20 statistics/fields per request; a batch that returns an invalid_request is bisected so the exact rejected field is captured.
